Callout.Name: Recovery Vehicle Broken Down
Callout.Message: Recovery vehicle broken down while towing.
Callout.Advisory: Both vehicles on the shoulder, lighting inadequate.

Script.Line: The truck itself has failed, so now there are two vehicles stuck.
The car on the back is held by a strap and one cone.
Somebody is going to come over that crest and it will be a mess.

Lines.Approach: The recovery truck has broken down with a car on the back of it, and it is lit by one cone.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
